description:
plan_block (src/compiler2/jobs/body.rs:3292) takes an owned ExprBlock
{ span, steps: Vec<ExprStep>, result }. At each step that splits the block
it builds the resume block with `steps: block.steps[index + 1..].to_vec()`
-- six sites: body.rs:3337, :3371, :3405, :3453, :3516, :3579. Each split
copies the rest of the block, and the resume block splits again, so a block
with n splitting steps copies O(n^2) steps.

Change: planning reads a slice. plan_block takes the remaining steps as
&[ExprStep] with span and result (both Copy) alongside; a resume is the
suffix slice, not a copy.

Before building: confirm nothing downstream of plan_block needs the owned
ExprBlock (stores it, mutates steps). If something does, record what and
why here before choosing the shape.

Depends on .2: both reshape what Lowerer owns versus borrows.

Removal ledger: the six to_vec copies; ExprBlock's Clone derive if nothing
else clones it.

Signal: gate green, no golden/census/pin movement. Measurement: lowering a
fixture with one long straight-line body of calls allocates proportionally
to its length -- report the before/after step-copy count.
title: plan_block resumes on a slice of the block's steps
